description:
[Trading Data API] Free, no signup required. CoinGecko global crypto stats (total market cap, 24h volume, BTC/ETH dominance) or top coins by market cap.

**Example:** `/v1/market-overview`

Use when you want global crypto stats: total market cap, 24h volume, BTC and ETH dominance. Not for a single asset's price (use price).

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.

limit.description: Optional (coins view). Number of coins (default 20, max 100).

name: market_overview
